name: Performing Combatant
prerequisites: Dazzling Display, any one performance feat
benefit:
You can make performance combat checks in any combat. When making a performance check outside of performance combat, you can pick a single performance feat to use. You automatically gain any bonus on the performance combat check the feat grants, and then you make a DC 20 performance combat check. On a success, you gain the full effect of the performance feat you chose.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 128
When using this feat, you can spend up to 5 stamina points to gain a bonus on your performance combat check equal to the number of stamina points you spent.
flavor: You treat every combat as a performance, bringing flare and showmanship.
